error.title: Something went wrong
error.versionConflict: Someone else saved first. Reload and re-apply your change.

campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.totalHint: Every delivery of the campaign, whatever its status: the ingest count, not a send count.
campaign.opensOverestimated: Opens are over-estimated: privacy proxies such as Apple Mail Privacy Protection fetch the pixel without a human reading the mail. Prefer the click metrics.
campaign.unsubscribeClickedHint: Redirect clicks, which a scanner may have caused. Only confirmed unsubscribes count towards the rate.
campaign.noLinks: The published version has no trackable links.
campaign.confirmStart: Start this campaign? Recipients are locked in once it runs.
campaign.confirmPause: Pause sending? In-flight deliveries finish first.
campaign.confirmCancel: Cancel this campaign? Queued deliveries are dropped and this cannot be undone.
campaign.confirmRetry: Requeue the failed deliveries of this campaign?
campaign.uploadHint: CSV or NDJSON. The file is streamed to the server, so a million rows never land in browser memory.
campaign.notStreaming: This browser cannot stream a request body, so each chunk is buffered before it is sent.

delivery.title: Deliveries
delivery.confirmRetryOne: Requeue this delivery? The attempt history is kept.
delivery.noAttempts: No attempt has been recorded yet.
delivery.noBounces: No bounce has been correlated to this delivery.
delivery.unverifiedHint: The VERP signature did not match, so this report never changed the delivery.

template.title: Templates
template.subject: Subject
template.textHint: Leave empty to derive it from the HTML.
template.confirmPublish: Publish this template? A new immutable message version is created.
template.publishMissingKeys: Publishing is blocked by untranslated keys.
template.previewMissing: Keys that fell through to the key string
template.editorFailed: The code editor could not be loaded; editing as plain text.

blockEditor.missingKeys: Keys the bundle does not define
blockEditor.failed: The block editor could not be started
blockEditor.projectFailed: The saved project could not be restored; the MJML was imported instead.
blockEditor.switchToCode: Copy the MJML the block editor exported into the code editor? The block project stays saved, but editing the code here will not update it.
blockEditor.switchToBlocks: Import the current MJML into the block editor? Anything the block editor cannot represent is dropped.

layout.title: Layouts
layout.bodyHint: MJML or HTML containing the {'{{'} content {'}}'} slot.

transport.title: Transports
transport.passwordSet: A password is stored; leave empty to keep it.
transport.rateHint: 0 is unlimited. The cluster target is split across active sender replicas.

sender.title: Senders
sender.verdictGreen: Everything passed, the mail landed in the inbox over TLS.
sender.verdictYellow: Degraded: spam folder, p=none, a PTR mismatch or no TLS.
sender.confirmProbe: Send a probe mail through this sender to every enabled probe mailbox?
sender.noRuns: No probe run recorded for this sender.

domain.title: Sending domains
domain.dkimKeySet: A key is stored; leave empty to keep it. Empty means the relay signs.
domain.outboundIpsHint: One per line. Observed from probe Received headers when left empty.

mailbox.title: Probe mailboxes
mailbox.passwordSet: A password is stored; leave empty to keep it.
mailbox.authservHint: Only Authentication-Results headers with this authserv-id are trusted (RFC 8601).
mailbox.hint: Register several mailboxes on the providers you actually send to: the verdict depends on the headers the receiving MTA adds.

bounceMailbox.title: Bounce mailboxes
bounceMailbox.passwordSet: A password is stored; leave empty to keep it.
bounceMailbox.folderHint: IMAP mailbox to read; empty means INBOX. Ignored under POP3.
bounceMailbox.afterProcessHint: keep, delete, or move:FOLDER (IMAP only). Empty means keep.
bounceMailbox.hint: One poller runs per mailbox cluster-wide, so a disabled mailbox is simply skipped.

stageHint.dial: Check the host, port and TLS mode.
stageHint.tls: Check the host, port and TLS mode.

mailboxTest.unsavedPasswordHint: Tests the password typed above; it is not saved by this test.

event.title: Events
event.confirmReplay: Queue this event for delivery again?

settings.title: Tenant settings
settings.backoffHint: One Go duration per line: the delay before attempt 1, 2, … The last entry repeats.
settings.maxAttemptsHint: Transient and rate-limited attempts only; auth and TLS faults do not count.
settings.retentionHint: How long deliveries, tracking events, bounces and probe runs are kept.
settings.suppressionHint: Turn off to manage suppression in the host application instead.
settings.bounceRetainRawHint: Off unless set, since an original can be megabytes and is kept for diagnosis rather than archival.

unsubscribeModes.sendplane: sendplane — signed tracking URL, redirect to the host
unsubscribeModes.host: host — the host URL goes in directly
unsubscribeModes.none: none — no link and no headers

settings.unsubscribeUrlHint: Liquid, evaluated per recipient. A recipient's own unsubscribe_url wins over it.
settings.oneClickHint: Under `sendplane` mode the List-Unsubscribe-Post header is always sent. Under `host` mode it is only sent when the host accepts the one-click POST.
settings.trackingDomainHint: Must resolve to the public /t routes. Required for opens, clicks and the sendplane unsubscribe mode.
settings.trackClicks: Rewrite links through the click redirect
settings.eventsNote: An empty selection subscribes to the default set: every event type except delivery.sent, delivery.opened and delivery.clicked.
settings.eventTypeSentHint: Writes one event per delivery, so a bulk campaign can produce a very large number of these.
